run_deformable_torus_simulation: run the pybullet deformable torus soft body simulation with Neo-Hookean material in GUI mode
load_soft_body_with_neo_hookean: load a soft body mesh using loadSoftBody with Neo-Hookean material parameters like Mu, Lambda, and Damping
configure_visual_shape_with_texture: change a body visual shape to apply an RGBA color and texture using changeVisualShape
setup_deformable_world_simulation: reset the simulation with RESET_USE_DEFORMABLE_WORLD and configure gravity and camera for deformable bodies
step_simulation_loop: run a continuous simulation loop using stepSimulation and getCameraImage while the physics client is connected
